idea.title: Your first WhatsApp reply: 4 things to send
idea.angle: A slow 'yes it's available' wastes the buyer's interest. A strong first reply confirms the listing, shares the key basics, asks one question and offers a viewing time.
idea.hook: SEND THESE 4 THINGS IN YOUR FIRST REPLY

slides.heading: "YES, IT'S AVAILABLE" IS **NOT ENOUGH**
slides.body: It answers one question and starts ten more. A buyer who waits hours has usually messaged three other agents by then.

slides.heading: CONFIRM THE **LISTING**
slides.body: Name the home, so they know you mean the right one. "Yes, the 4-bed with the pool is available."

slides.heading: SHARE THE **BASICS**
slides.body: Bedrooms, bathrooms, price and area. Answer what they were about to ask next.

slides.heading: ASK **ONE** QUESTION
slides.body: Just one, to keep the chat going. "When are you hoping to move?"

slides.heading: OFFER A **VIEWING** TIME
slides.body: Don't ask "When are you free?" Offer a slot: "I can show you Saturday at 10. Does that work?"

slides.heading: ONE REPLY, NOT **TEN**
slides.body:
Before: "Yes, it's available."
After: Yes, the 4-bed with the pool is available.
4 bed · 3 bath · [Price] · [Area]
When are you hoping to move?
I can show you Saturday at 10.

slides.heading: REPLY ONCE. BOOK THE **VIEWING**.
slides.body: Save this and use it in your next reply

caption:
"Yes, it's available" is not a reply. It's a delay.

A strong first reply does four things.
It confirms the listing and shares the basics.
It asks one question and offers a viewing time.
One good message beats ten slow ones.

Save this and use it in your next reply.
